movie.title: Animals
movie.overview: When the son of an L.A. mayoral candidate is kidnapped, he and his wife have a few hours to come up with the ransom payment. With most of their money spent on his political campaign, they have to get their hands dirty and expose a side of their lives they never intended to see the light of day.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When an L.A. mayoral candidate's son is kidnapped and ransom funds are depleted by his campaign, he and his wife must enter a dark world to secure the money in time.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: An ambitious L.A. mayoral candidate faces every parent's nightmare when his young son is kidnapped and held for ransom. Having spent virtually all of their wealth financing his high-stakes political campaign, the desperate couple has only a few hours to gather the cash. To save their child, they are forced to engage in illicit activities and expose dark secrets they fought hard to keep hidden. Their search for redemption reveals the corrupt underbelly of power, ambition, and personal sacrifice.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In the fast-paced political landscape of Los Angeles, a prominent mayoral candidate appears to have everything until his world shatters when his son is kidnapped. The captors demand a massive ransom within hours, placing an agonizing ticking clock on the family. Unfortunately, the candidate and his wife have poured their entire fortune into funding his political ambitions, leaving them virtually broke. Unwilling to go to the police and risk their son's life or derail the campaign, the couple takes matters into their own hands. They dive deep into the city's criminal underworld, resorting to desperate and illicit measures to acquire the necessary funds before the deadline. Along the way, the intense pressure forces them to confront the moral compromises they have made in pursuit of status and success. Secrets they swore to take to the grave are slowly dragged into the light, threatening to destroy their marriage and reputation. As time rapidly runs out, they discover that the line between predator and prey is dangerously thin. Ultimately, saving their son requires them to sacrifice their polished image and embrace a ruthless side of themselves they never knew existed.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Animals is a high-stakes crime drama thriller set in Los Angeles, centered on an up-and-coming mayoral candidate and his wife whose lives are thrown into chaos when their son is suddenly abducted. Demanding a substantial cash ransom within a matter of hours, the kidnappers leave the couple with little time and zero room for error. Compounding the tragedy, the family finds themselves financially overextended after channeling their entire fortune into an expensive political campaign. Desperate to save their child without exposing their vulnerability to the public or authorities, the parents embark on a harrowing journey through the dark underbelly of the city to raise the funds by any means necessary. As they cross moral lines and uncover hidden truths about their own pasts, this intense suspense thriller explores the lengths parents will go to protect their family when pushed to the absolute brink.

story_structure.resolution: The ordeal draws to a close as the immediate threat is resolved, leaving the parents to reckon with the lasting fallout of their exposed secrets.
